goal: Expand genuine Act1 Ironclad A0 combat practice across both regions, all elites/bosses, potions and attack/block contexts.
sampling: Equal room-kind schedule; uniform encounter, then source combat within kind. Half opening, half continuation when that combat has continuations; uniform later turn.

start_verification.checks: Two independent exact restores per start; public digest, one direct legal action, unchanged second instance.

rejected_collection.issue: Sorted snapshot keys reordered visible potion powers in some continuations; rejected by exact public-state verification, no training or benchmark used it.

limitations: Only fights reached by the frozen collector are represented; no failed source is retried.
Late-fight inventories are conditioned on surviving the source campaign prefix.
Coverage gaps are reported, not filled with assisted or invented inventory.
Fights in one campaign share a source group and must remain in the same split.
Later-turn starts are collector-conditioned practice states, not independent full-fight evaluations.
Threat categories use displayed attack damage minus current block, not a simulated outcome forecast.
Collection actions are not expert labels; more starts do not establish improved policy quality.
Restored combat episodes begin with fresh adapter history.
All expansion evidence is headless; no new native/live gameplay claim.
This is an expanded start population and baseline measurement, not evidence of an improved trained policy.
Combat-local training does not itself teach conserving potions for future rooms.
Policy checkpoints retain their original frozen vocabulary; a fresh warm-up on expanded demonstrations can fit newly encountered tokens.
Version-1 corpora remain historical artifacts; exact resume cannot switch corpus identities.
